audit: fresh independent seed-v2 question/key scope challenge
isolation: No summaries, reader answers, grades, reviews or QA history read. Only designated seed files and original sources inspected.
method: Question wording controls required scope. A true unasked rule remains context even when bundled inside a required fact. Equivalent complete calculation resolves its components; no separate prose recital needed. Source completeness and answer correctness are separate.

questions.question: What is the ordinary phase order, when does trading end, and may players still invent immediately before running their Economy?
asked_clause_requirements: Ordinary phases: Trade, Economy, Confluence.
Trade ends when all but one player is done.
Immediate invention remains possible before Economy.

fact_audit.fact: Trade then Economy then Confluence
Confluence shares technologies before colony bids before research bids
fact_audit.scope_rationale: The ordinary phase order clause clearly requires Trade/Economy/Confluence; it does not expressly ask the internal order of Confluence activities. Treat that suborder as explanatory context, not a standalone omission penalty.

fact_audit.fact: Trade ends when all but one player are done
Immediate invention allowed before Economy

contextual_background_audit.text: Other Trade abilities may also be used at this boundary; not separately asked.

over_required.reason: The ordinary phase order clause clearly requires Trade/Economy/Confluence; it does not expressly ask the internal order of Confluence activities. Treat that suborder as explanatory context, not a standalone omission penalty.

source_references: Rulebook p6 Phases and Trade Phase
questions.scope_verdict: required-fact scope narrower than compound key; preserve asked atoms
questions.scope_note: Phase-order suborder is an interpretive boundary, not a source error. Full sequence remains acceptable in an answer.

fact_audit.fact: 2 per card and octagon; 1 per cube and ship
Loss is 7 points
Score may go negative

contextual_background_audit.text: With no agreed compensation fulfill as much as possible

source_references: Rulebook p6 Trade Phase, failed promises
